# dependency-checker
> Offline package.json analyzer for loose versions, duplicates, and invalid semver

Offline static analyzer for `package.json`. Detects loose version ranges (`*`, `latest`), duplicate dependencies, invalid semver, non-npm specifiers (git/file/http), and engine misconfigurations. Works without network. ```typescript import { DependencyChecker } from 'dependency-checker';

## API
- `Issue`
- `AnalysisResult`
- `DependencyChecker`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/Ruzylo-cloud.
